title: Local identifier renaming
description: Rename local variables and parameters consistently while leaving function names, field names, and call callees unchanged.
preconditions: rename only locally declared identifiers
avoid collisions and reserved keywords
update all bound uses consistently

title: Identifier naming-style conversion
description: Convert a local identifier among camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and underscore-prefixed variants while preserving binding.
preconditions: local identifiers only
avoid collisions
preserve binding

title: Standalone update-form equivalence
description: Rewrite standalone increment/decrement statements among prefix, postfix, compound assignment, and binary assignment forms.
preconditions: the update value must not be consumed
operate only on standalone update statements in safe mode

title: Loop-condition representation
description: Rewrite equivalent infinite-loop condition forms using only language-valid alternatives.
preconditions: Java never uses integer 1 as a boolean condition
while-loop omission is not allowed
for-loop omission is allowed
example: C++/JS: while(true) <-> while(1); Java: for(;;) <-> for(;true;)

title: Explicit default indexOf start position
description: Make the default start position explicit for a conservatively recognized built-in string/array indexOf call.
preconditions: receiver must be recognized as a built-in string/array value
do not rewrite unknown user-defined indexOf methods

title: Null-comparison operand swap
description: Swap operands of equality/inequality comparisons around null-like literals.
preconditions: comparison operator must be equality or inequality
one operand must be null/nullptr/NULL

title: Emptiness and size equivalence
description: Rewrite emptiness checks for statically recognized standard containers.
preconditions: receiver type must be a recognized standard container
unknown/custom types must be skipped
example: Java: xs.isEmpty() <-> xs.size() == 0; C++: xs.empty() <-> xs.size() == 0

title: Variable declaration repositioning
description: Move declaration-only statements within lexical scope while leaving initialization at the original logical point.
preconditions: move only before first use
C++ safe mode restricts to scalar built-in types
JavaScript is skipped because TDZ/hoisting can change behavior
example: int x = f(); -> int x; ... x = f();

title: for/while loop conversion
description: Convert between for and while forms while preserving initialization, updates, and same-loop continue behavior.
preconditions: preserve update execution before same-loop continue
do not move updates across nested loop boundaries

title: Nested/compound if conversion
description: Convert nested if statements without else branches to a conjunction, and vice versa.
preconditions: neither participating if may have an else branch

title: Conditional structural rewriting
description: Rewrite eligible switch statements to if/else chains and ternary assignments to if/else assignments.
preconditions: switch cases must not fall through
switch selector must be side-effect-free because an if-chain may reevaluate it
ternary rewrite is restricted to simple assignments

title: Conditional branch swap
description: Negate an if condition and exchange then/else branches.
preconditions: an else branch must exist
condition negation must preserve precedence
